Classifier rules revised hand validation 300 filings (dev/validation/; PLAN.md section 9). Agreement hand labels rose 62% 70%, merger recall 51% 71%. merger_rules(min_top_share = 0.75): default 0.5. share test now always applies, several nonprofit recipients. merger_rules(final_as_termination = TRUE): Part-II-filings final-return box treated terminations. New TERMINATED column. merger_rules(sn_text = TRUE): merger language Schedule N’s text (SN_MERGER_TEXT sn_filings(), pattern sn_merger_pattern()) merger evidence , BASIS = "sn_text". merger_rules(promote = FALSE) now default. 1 13 promoted filings read merger. Set promote = TRUE broad definition. build_merger_data() runs whole pipeline returns every table. accepts pre-fetched inputs, npmerger_example() runs offline. Merger cases: build_merger_cases() (merger IDs, groups, merger year organization’s fiscal calendar), merger_roles(), transfer_value() (FMV asset class, coverage donor’s assets, outlier flags), asset_class(). Core data: get_core(), org_years() (one return per organization-year), merger_measures() (harmonized 990 / 990-EZ revenue, expenses, assets, debt, staff costs, executive pay, grants, overhead). get_bmf() adds NTEE codes ruling years. Analysis tables: merger_attributes() (donor recipient attributes five years size history), merger_part7() (Part VII rosters t-2 t+2 IN_BOTH), merger_fiscal_panel() (measures, ‘fiscal’ ratios, optional fixed-calibration index, optional trailing smoothing via smooth_trailing()). recover_recipient_ein() recovers missing recipient EINs unique name ZIP state match 990 filers (get_name_index()). Merger evidence: get_evidence_tables() reads 990 header, Part VII, Part VI, Schedule O, Schedule R, Schedule , mission tables donors recipients set filings. merger_features() adds: Part VII leadership overlap (leader_overlap()), counts dissolving donors sharing successor (add_donor_counts()), donor recipient filing history new-entity detection (add_filing_history()), corroborating disclosures (add_corroboration()), affiliation (add_affiliation()), mission similarity (add_mission_similarity()). classify_transactions() can promote asset transfer merger least two corroborating signals agree, records BASIS N_CORROBORATE. pkgdown site using NODC pkgstyle template, overview vignette.
